modeSelect.heading: How is Glaon connecting to Home Assistant?
modeSelect.subheading: Pick the option that matches where you are right now. You can change this later from the settings menu.

local.title: Local — same Wi-Fi as your home
local.description: Sign in directly to Home Assistant. Fastest, no Glaon cloud account needed.
local.probing: Looking for a Home Assistant on your network…
local.notFound: Couldn't auto-detect Home Assistant; pick this option to enter the URL manually.

cloud.title: Cloud — anywhere on the internet
cloud.description: Sign in with your Glaon account. Connects through the Glaon relay.
cloud.unavailable: Cloud is not configured for this build.

manual.label: Or enter your Home Assistant URL manually

shell.signedInPlaceholder: Signed in. The Phase 2 dashboard lands once #10–#12 wire the HA WebSocket.

cloudUnavailable.body: VITE_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY is not configured for this build.

homeOverview.title: Home Overview
homeOverview.subtitle: Tell us about your home so Glaon can localize units, time, and language for you.

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.tooltip: Used by HA-time displays and automations.

language.label: Language
language.tooltip: Glaon UI language. Changes apply on the next reload.

layoutSetup.title: Layout Setup
layoutSetup.subtitle: Add the floors and rooms in your home. Glaon uses them to group devices and surface the right controls per space.
layoutSetup.label: Layout

rooms.emptyHint: Add the rooms you want to control on this floor — bedrooms, kitchen, bath, anything Glaon should know about.

handoff.title: Switch this device to {ssid}
handoff.description: Glaon will save your credentials and tell the device to join {ssid}. Your phone or laptop will lose its connection to the device for a moment — that's expected.
handoff.bullet1: The device drops its setup Wi-Fi and joins {ssid}.
handoff.bullet2: Your phone or laptop loses the connection. Switch it to your home Wi-Fi.
handoff.bullet3: Reopen the setup page at {url}. Scan the QR code to make this easy.
handoff.passwordHint: Re-typed so a stray key doesn't lock you out of the device.

overlay.title: Switching to {ssid}…
overlay.description: Your device is joining {ssid}. This usually takes 10–30 seconds. Don't refresh this page.
overlay.nudge: Still here? Switch your phone or laptop to {ssid} and reopen {url}.

security.title: Device Security
security.subtitle: Set the admin password for this device. Anyone who needs to change the setup will need it.

hashFailed.title: Couldn't hash the password
hashFailed.description: Your browser blocked the Web Crypto API. Try a different browser or contact your administrator.

network.title: Network
network.subtitle: Set this device's hostname and how each interface gets its address, then pick the Wi-Fi network it should join.
network.loadFailed: We couldn't load the current network configuration. The Home Assistant add-on may be restarting.
network.unavailable: Network configuration isn't available in this environment, so we'll skip it. Your other settings will still be saved.

hostname.label: Hostname
hostname.hint: The name this device uses on your network.
hostname.invalid: Use 1–63 letters, digits, or hyphens (no leading or trailing hyphen).

address.label: IP address
address.required: An IP address is required for a static configuration.
address.invalid: Enter a valid address, optionally with a /prefix (e.g. 192.168.1.50/24).

dns.label: DNS servers
dns.invalid: Enter valid DNS addresses, separated by commas.

wifi.heading: Wi-Fi network
wifi.subtitle: Pick the network this device should join after setup. Glaon switches to it when you click Save.

password.label: Network password
password.optionalHint: Optional — leave empty for an open network. We'll ask again in the confirmation dialog so a typo can't lock you out.

wifi.empty: No Wi-Fi networks found nearby. Move closer to your router or try again.
wifi.unavailable: Wi-Fi scanning isn't available in this environment, so we'll skip the network switch. Your other settings will still be saved.

scanFailed.title: Couldn't scan Wi-Fi networks
scanFailed.description: Home Assistant didn't respond to the network scan. Check that the add-on is running and try again.
scanFailed.body: We couldn't reach the Home Assistant network scanner. The add-on may be restarting.

apply.title: Save and apply
apply.subtitle: Double-check your settings, pick your home Wi-Fi, and we'll switch the device over.

commitFailed.title: Couldn't complete setup
commitFailed.description: Home Assistant didn't accept the configuration. Check the connection and try again.

haSettingsFailed.title: Couldn't save settings to Home Assistant
haSettingsFailed.description: We didn't switch your Wi-Fi yet. Some home settings couldn't be applied — check the connection and try again.
